notes: Customer is a regional analytics org for municipal services — high regulatory sensitivity.
Primary ask: Private VPC where all data + telemetry cannot leave EU jurisdictions (legal must sign off).
"No telemetry outside EU" — paraphrase from CTO; considered a legal redline.
Prefers customer-managed keys (CMK). Open to Azure Key Vault HSM or AWS KMS with multi-account policy; must demonstrate HSM-backed keys stored in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1.
Audit logging: 1 year retention, delivery to their Splunk/S3 bucket in EU. Need schema for all request metadata.
Operational needs: route-by-region control (pin models to EU nodes), deterministic fallback to smaller quantized variant in same region if capacity constrained.
Performance targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 120ms on chat workloads; embeddings throughput target ~800 q/s for nightly batch.
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to hit cost target.
Quote from CTO: 'If telemetry leaves the EU we can't proceed — need ironclad controls and an attestation.'
POC plan: 3-week private VPC pilot; provide test harness, sample eval prompts, and KMS key rotation demo.
